results.description:
JULIETTE

I dance in pink for strangers because my mother's hospital bills ended up in my name, and every dollar I make goes toward a number I'll be paying until I'm fifty.

My best friend gave me three rules on my first night. Trust nobody. Never go home with a regular. And never, ever look twice at the owner.

I broke all three in a single week.

He paid a thousand dollars just to hear me say my real name. He knew where I lived before I ever told him. Men who touch me on his floor disappear, and he looks at me like I'm the answer to a question he's been asking for years.

I should run. Everyone tells me to run.

But he's the only one who ever noticed my lock was broken.

ANGELO

I own the club, the city, and most of the men in it. I don't ask for anything. I take it, or I arrange for it to be mine.

Then a girl in a pink costume walked into my red room and gave me a fake name, and I knew I was finished.

She doesn't want my money. She doesn't want my protection. She looks at me like I'm the worst thing that ever happened to her, and she might be right.

I'll give her everything she's ever lost. And I'll take away everything else, until the only door left open is mine.

She can fight me. She can hate me. She can tell me no, and I'll stop.

But I will never let her go.

This is the first book in The Volkov King Series. Reading order:

King of Sin.

King of Vice.

King of Wrath.
